name: 39 Principles for Designing Human–AI Interaction
summary: Article laying out 39 applied design principles, in nine themes, for human–AI interaction in products.
description: A framework article published Jun 30, 2026 that turns research on human–AI interaction, mixed-initiative systems and trust in automation into practical interface principles. Nine themes - probabilistic foundation, expectation setting, calibrated trust, transparency, control and agency, graceful failure, co-creation, responsible autonomy and sustained reliance - illustrated with examples from real products.
contains: draws on the PAIR Guidebook, Microsoft's 18 guidelines and frontier model specs
product examples such as Linear's AI triage
